xna-type.name: GamePadTriggers
xna-type.summary: Structure that defines the position of the left and right triggers on an Xbox 360 Controller.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the GamePadTriggers class.

parameters.parameter: Type: Single Left trigger value. This value is clamped between 0.0 and 1.0.
Type: Single Right trigger value. This value is clamped between 0.0 and 1.0.

constructor.remarks: Games normally use GetState to get the true gamepad state. This constructor is used instead to simulate gamepad input for passing within the game's own input subsystem.

property.name: Left
property.summary: Identifies the position of the left trigger on the Xbox 360 Controller.

property.name: Right
property.summary: Identifies the position of the right trigger on the Xbox 360 Controller.
